integrity: Exact formulas are proved for every finite path size. The standalone exact-rational tests are supplemental; they do not substitute for an all-size proof. Novelty is assessed against retrieved primary literature with residual publication-priority risk for inaccessible specialized work.
scientific_limitations: Unit-rate symmetric nearest-neighbor paths with reflecting boundary, classical explicit RK4 final update, and exact arithmetic only. No claim about intermediate stages, arbitrary graphs, numerical roundoff, absolute-stability limits, or all time integrators.
title: Exact positivity horizons of fourth-order Runge–Kutta on reflecting heat paths
